<script>
(function() {
  'use strict';
  var topCards = document.querySelectorAll('.top-games-grid .game-card');
  if (!topCards.length) return;

  var baseRtp = [99.2, 98.8, 98.4, 98.0, 97.5, 97.1, 96.8, 96.5];

  function updateTopGamesRtp() {
    topCards.forEach(function(card, index) {
      var rtpValueEl = card.querySelector('.rtp-value');
      var rtpProgressBarEl = card.querySelector('.rtp-progress');
      if (!rtpValueEl || !rtpProgressBarEl) return;

      var currentBase = baseRtp[index];
      var delta = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.5;
      var newVal = Math.max(95.8, Math.min(99.8, currentBase + delta));
      baseRtp[index] = newVal;

      var formatted = newVal.toFixed(1) + '%';
      rtpValueEl.textContent = formatted;
      rtpProgressBarEl.style.transition = 'width 0.8s ease-in-out';
      rtpProgressBarEl.style.width = formatted;
    });
  }

  // Update initial smooth transition & interval
  setInterval(updateTopGamesRtp, 2800);
})();
</script>

<script>
(function(){
  'use strict';

  var OFFERS = [
    {
      id: 'hari-ini',
      title: 'PENAWARAN HARI INI',
      tabLabel1: 'HARI INI',
      tabLabel2: 'TERSEDIA',
      emoji: '🔥',
      desc: 'Dapatkan berbagai penawaran menarik hari ini secara eksklusif. Diperbarui secara real-time setiap jam dengan promo slots & game terbaik!',
      badge: 'TERSEDIA',
      btnText: 'Lihat Detail',
      link: 'https://sgacor.purbalinggakab-x.com/',
      gradient: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #f59e0b 0%, #ea580c 100%)',
      colorTheme: '#ea580c',
      highlightText: '🔥 Promo Eksklusif Hari Ini Terbatas!'
    },
    {
      id: 'cashback',
      title: 'CASHBACK MINGGUAN',
      tabLabel1: 'CASHBACK',
      tabLabel2: 'MINGGUAN',
      emoji: '🎁',
      desc: 'Bermain aman dengan jaminan cashback rollingan hingga 1.5% tanpa batas. Masuk otomatis ke saldo Anda setiap hari Senin siang.',
      badge: 'MINGGUAN',
      btnText: 'Lihat Cashback',
      link: 'https://sgacor.purbalinggakab-x.com/',
      gradient: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #0ea5e9 0%, #1d4ed8 100%)',
      colorTheme: '#0ea5e9',
      highlightText: '🎁 Cashback Terbesar Tanpa Batas Rollover!'
    },
    {
      id: 'event',
      title: 'EVENT SPESIAL',
      tabLabel1: 'EVENT',
      tabLabel2: 'SPESIAL',
      emoji: '⚡',
      desc: 'Ikuti kemeriahan turnamen musiman dengan total hadiah miliaran rupiah. Semua member berkesempatan memenangkan jackpot spektakuler.',
      badge: 'SPESIAL',
      btnText: 'Ikuti Event',
      link: 'https://sgacor.purbalinggakab-x.com/',
      gradient: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #a855f7 0%, #6d28d9 100%)',
      colorTheme: '#a855f7',
      highlightText: '⚡ Event Terpopuler Hadiah Rp 5.000.000.000!'
    },
    {
      id: 'bonus',
      title: 'BONUS SUPER',
      tabLabel1: 'BONUS',
      tabLabel2: 'SUPER',
      emoji: '💎',
      desc: 'Klaim bonus tambahan deposit harian melimpah. Tambah terus saldo bermain Anda dan raih kemenangan maxwin lebih mudah!',
      badge: 'BONUS',
      btnText: 'Ambil Bonus',
      link: 'https://sgacor.purbalinggakab-x.com/',
      gradient: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #ef4444 0%, #b91c1c 100%)',
      colorTheme: '#ef4444',
      highlightText: '🎁 Bonus Saldo Ekstra Deposit Harian!'
    },
    {
      id: 'member',
      title: 'PENAWARAN MEMBER BARU',
      tabLabel1: 'MEMBER',
      tabLabel2: 'BARU',
      emoji: '👑',
      desc: 'Selamat bergabung! Dapatkan welcome bonus deposit hingga 100% dan freespin eksklusif untuk member yang baru mendaftar hari ini.',
      badge: 'MEMBER BARU',
      btnText: 'Daftar & Klaim',
      link: 'https://sgacor.purbalinggakab-x.com/',
      gradient: 'linear-gradient(135deg, #10b981 0%, #047857 100%)',
      colorTheme: '#10b981',
      highlightText: '👑 Welcome Bonus 100% Khusus Member Baru!'
    }
  ];

  var AUTOPLAY_TIME = 6000; // 6 seconds
  var currentIndex = 0;
  var progressInterval = 50; // ms
  var progressTime = 0;
  var autoplayTimer = null;
  var progressTimer = null;

  /* Elements */
  var E = function(id) { return document.getElementById(id); };
  var activeCard   = E('oc-active-card');
  var cardBadge    = E('oc-card-badge');
  var cardIcon     = E('oc-card-icon');
  var cardTitle    = E('oc-card-title');
  var cardDesc     = E('oc-card-desc');
  var cardHighlight= E('oc-card-highlight');
  var cardCtaBtn   = E('oc-card-cta-btn');
  var cardCtaText  = E('oc-card-cta-text');
  
  var prevBtn      = E('oc-nav-prev');
  var nextBtn      = E('oc-nav-next');
  var progressBar  = E('oc-progress-bar');
  var tabsGrid     = E('oc-tabs-grid');
  
  var claimCountEl = E('oc-claim-count');
  var tickerTrack  = E('oc-ticker-track');

  /* Live claims counter state */
  var baseClaims = 142583;
  
  function updateClaimCounter() {
    baseClaims += Math.floor(Math.random() * 4) + 1;
    claimCountEl.textContent = baseClaims.toLocaleString('id-ID');
  }
  
  // Set initial count
  claimCountEl.textContent = baseClaims.toLocaleString('id-ID');
  // Update counter randomly every 2 to 4 seconds
  setInterval(updateClaimCounter, 2500);

  /* Build tabs bottom cards */
  function renderTabs() {
    tabsGrid.innerHTML = '';
    OFFERS.forEach(function(offer, idx) {
      var tab = document.createElement('div');
      tab.className = 'oc-tab-card' + (idx === currentIndex ? ' active' : '');
      tab.style.setProperty('--theme-color', offer.colorTheme);
      tab.innerHTML = 
        '<span class="oc-tab-emoji">' + offer.emoji + '</span>' +
        '<span class="oc-tab-title">' + offer.tabLabel1 + '</span>' +
        '<span class="oc-tab-subtitle">' + offer.tabLabel2 + '</span>' +
        '<span class="oc-tab-btn">Lihat</span>';
      
      tab.addEventListener('click', function() {
        goToSlide(idx);
      });
      tabsGrid.appendChild(tab);
    });
  }

  /* Render active slide */
  function renderActiveSlide(idx) {
    var offer = OFFERS[idx];
    
    // Add fade animation class
    activeCard.classList.remove('oc-slide-fade');
    void activeCard.offsetWidth; // Trigger reflow
    activeCard.classList.add('oc-slide-fade');
    
    // Update card styling and text
    activeCard.style.background = offer.gradient;
    activeCard.style.setProperty('--theme-color', offer.colorTheme);
    cardBadge.textContent = offer.badge;
    cardIcon.textContent = offer.emoji;
    cardTitle.textContent = offer.title;
    cardDesc.textContent = offer.desc;
    cardHighlight.textContent = offer.highlightText;
    cardCtaText.textContent = offer.btnText;
    cardCtaBtn.href = offer.link;
    
    // Highlight correct tab
    var tabs = tabsGrid.children;
    for (var i = 0; i < tabs.length; i++) {
      if (i === idx) {
        tabs[i].classList.add('active');
      } else {
        tabs[i].classList.remove('active');
      }
    }
  }

  /* Navigation */
  function nextSlide() {
    currentIndex = (currentIndex + 1) % OFFERS.length;
    renderActiveSlide(currentIndex);
    resetTimers();
  }

  function prevSlide() {
    currentIndex = (currentIndex - 1 + OFFERS.length) % OFFERS.length;
    renderActiveSlide(currentIndex);
    resetTimers();
  }

  function goToSlide(idx) {
    currentIndex = idx;
    renderActiveSlide(currentIndex);
    resetTimers();
  }

  /* Autoplay progress timers */
  function startTimers() {
    progressTime = 0;
    progressBar.style.width = '0%';
    
    progressTimer = setInterval(function() {
      progressTime += progressInterval;
      var percentage = (progressTime / AUTOPLAY_TIME) * 100;
      progressBar.style.width = Math.min(100, percentage) + '%';
    }, progressInterval);

    autoplayTimer = setInterval(function() {
      nextSlide();
    }, AUTOPLAY_TIME);
  }

  function resetTimers() {
    clearInterval(autoplayTimer);
    clearInterval(progressTimer);
    startTimers();
  }

  /* Setup Nav Listeners */
  prevBtn.addEventListener('click', prevSlide);
  nextBtn.addEventListener('click', nextSlide);

  /* Initialize Ticker */
  var USERS = ['user_wd', 'slot_gk', 'maxwin', 'jp_hunter', 'pragmatic', 'member', 'pemenang', 'cuan', 'hoki', 'macan'];

  function generateRandomClaim() {
    var user = USERS[Math.floor(Math.random() * USERS.length)] + '***' + Math.floor(Math.random() * 900 + 100);
    var offerIdx = Math.floor(Math.random() * OFFERS.length);
    var offer = OFFERS[offerIdx];
    var amount = 'IDR ' + (Math.floor(Math.random() * 20 + 2) * 25000).toLocaleString('id-ID');
    var time = '1s ago';
    
    return {
      user: user,
      offerTitle: offer.title.replace(/^[^\s]+\s+/, ''), // Strip emoji
      offerColor: offer.colorTheme,
      offerEmoji: offer.emoji,
      amount: amount,
      time: time
    };
  }

  // Pre-seed 3 items on initialization
  for (var i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
    var item = generateRandomClaim();
    var itemEl = document.createElement('div');
    itemEl.className = 'oc-ticker-item';
    itemEl.style.setProperty('--offer-color', item.offerColor);
    itemEl.innerHTML = 
      '<span class="oc-ticker-user">' + item.user + '</span>' +
      '<span class="oc-ticker-action">mengklaim</span>' +
      '<span class="oc-ticker-offer">' + item.offerEmoji + ' ' + item.offerTitle + '</span>' +
      '<span class="oc-ticker-amount">+' + item.amount + '</span>' +
      '<span class="oc-ticker-time">' + item.time + '</span>';
    tickerTrack.appendChild(itemEl);
  }

  function animateTicker() {
    var newItem = generateRandomClaim();
    var itemEl = document.createElement('div');
    itemEl.className = 'oc-ticker-item';
    itemEl.style.setProperty('--offer-color', newItem.offerColor);
    itemEl.innerHTML = 
      '<span class="oc-ticker-user">' + newItem.user + '</span>' +
      '<span class="oc-ticker-action">mengklaim</span>' +
      '<span class="oc-ticker-offer">' + newItem.offerEmoji + ' ' + newItem.offerTitle + '</span>' +
      '<span class="oc-ticker-amount">+' + newItem.amount + '</span>' +
      '<span class="oc-ticker-time">' + newItem.time + '</span>';
    
    tickerTrack.appendChild(itemEl);
    
    tickerTrack.style.transition = 'transform 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.76, 0, 0.24, 1)';
    tickerTrack.style.transform = 'translateY(-24px)';
    
    setTimeout(function() {
      if (tickerTrack.children.length > 0) {
        tickerTrack.removeChild(tickerTrack.firstElementChild);
      }
      tickerTrack.style.transition = 'none';
      tickerTrack.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
    }, 600);
  }

  // Initial render
  renderTabs();
  renderActiveSlide(0);
  startTimers();
  
  // Animate ticker every 3 seconds
  setInterval(animateTicker, 3000);
})();
</script>

<script>
(function() {
  'use strict';
  
  // Real-time counter jackpot
  var jpEl = document.getElementById('lp-global-jackpot');
  var currentJp = 8431063089; // Sync with user's latest screenshot state
  
  function updateJackpot() {
    // Add small random increments to make the jackpot feel alive
    var add = Math.floor(Math.random() * 2500) + 500;
    currentJp += add;
    
    // Format to IDR local currency style
    jpEl.textContent = currentJp.toLocaleString('id-ID');
  }
  
  setInterval(updateJackpot, 1200);

  // Live Jackpot Winners Feed
  var winnersTrack = document.getElementById('jp-winners-track');
  
  var GAMES = [
    { name: 'Gates of Olympus 1000', provider: 'Pragmatic Play', emoji: '⚡' },
    { name: 'Mahjong Ways 2', provider: 'PG Soft', emoji: '🀄' },
    { name: 'Sweet Bonanza 1000', provider: 'Pragmatic Play', emoji: '🍬' },
    { name: 'Starlight Princess 1000', provider: 'Pragmatic Play', emoji: '👑' },
    { name: 'Sugar Rush 1000', provider: 'Pragmatic Play', emoji: '🍭' },
    { name: 'Wild Bandito', provider: 'PG Soft', emoji: '🤠' },
    { name: 'Treasure of Aztec', provider: 'PG Soft', emoji: '🗿' },
    { name: 'Gates of Gatot Kaca 1000', provider: 'Pragmatic Play', emoji: '⚡' },
    { name: 'Fortune Tiger', provider: 'PG Soft', emoji: '🐯' },
    { name: 'Lucky Neko', provider: 'PG Soft', emoji: '🐱' }
  ];

  var USERS = ['macan', 'slot', 'jp', 'maxwin', 'hoki', 'cuan', 'pemenang', 'cazh', 'spin', 'play'];

  function pad(n) { return String(n).padStart(2, '0'); }

  function getFormattedDateTime(offsetMs) {
    var date = new Date(Date.now() - (offsetMs || 0));
    var day = pad(date.getDate());
    var month = pad(date.getMonth() + 1);
    var year = date.getFullYear();
    var hours = pad(date.getHours());
    var minutes = pad(date.getMinutes());
    var seconds = pad(date.getSeconds());
    return day + '-' + month + '-' + year + ' ' + hours + ':' + minutes + ':' + seconds;
  }

  function generateWinnerData(offsetMs) {
    var user = USERS[Math.floor(Math.random() * USERS.length)] + '***' + Math.floor(Math.random() * 900 + 100);
    var game = GAMES[Math.floor(Math.random() * GAMES.length)];
    // Large jackpot amounts (IDR 15,000,000 to IDR 350,000,000)
    var amount = 'IDR ' + (Math.floor(Math.random() * 335 + 15) * 1000000).toLocaleString('id-ID');
    var timestamp = getFormattedDateTime(offsetMs);
    
    return {
      user: user,
      gameName: game.name,
      gameProvider: game.provider,
      gameEmoji: game.emoji,
      amount: amount,
      time: timestamp
    };
  }

  // Pre-seed 4 winners to populate list instantly
  var seedOffsets = [42000, 25000, 12000, 0];
  seedOffsets.forEach(function(offset) {
    var winner = generateWinnerData(offset);
    var row = document.createElement('div');
    row.className = 'jp-winner-row';
    row.innerHTML = 
      '<div class="jp-col-game">' +
        '<span class="jp-game-icon">' + winner.gameEmoji + '</span>' +
        '<div class="jp-game-details">' +
          '<span class="jp-game-name">' + winner.gameName + '</span>' +
          '<span class="jp-game-provider">' + winner.gameProvider + '</span>' +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="jp-col-user">' + winner.user + '</div>' +
      '<div class="jp-col-time">' + winner.time + '</div>' +
      '<div class="jp-col-amount"><span class="jp-amount-badge">' + winner.amount + '</span></div>';
    winnersTrack.appendChild(row);
  });

  function animateWinners() {
    var newWinner = generateWinnerData(0);
    var row = document.createElement('div');
    row.className = 'jp-winner-row';
    row.innerHTML = 
      '<div class="jp-col-game">' +
        '<span class="jp-game-icon">' + newWinner.gameEmoji + '</span>' +
        '<div class="jp-game-details">' +
          '<span class="jp-game-name">' + newWinner.gameName + '</span>' +
          '<span class="jp-game-provider">' + newWinner.gameProvider + '</span>' +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<div class="jp-col-user">' + newWinner.user + '</div>' +
      '<div class="jp-col-time">' + newWinner.time + '</div>' +
      '<div class="jp-col-amount"><span class="jp-amount-badge">' + newWinner.amount + '</span></div>';
    
    winnersTrack.appendChild(row);
    
    // Shift track upward by one row (48px height + 8px gap = 56px)
    winnersTrack.style.transition = 'transform 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.76, 0, 0.24, 1)';
    winnersTrack.style.transform = 'translateY(-56px)';
    
    setTimeout(function() {
      if (winnersTrack.children.length > 0) {
        winnersTrack.removeChild(winnersTrack.firstElementChild);
      }
      winnersTrack.style.transition = 'none';
      winnersTrack.style.transform = 'translateY(0)';
    }, 600);
  }

  // Shift/append a new jackpot winner every 5 seconds
  setInterval(animateWinners, 5000);

  // ==========================================
  // LIVE DASHBOARD: TREN KEMENANGAN & JAM GACOR
  // ==========================================
  
  var chartPoints = [
    { x: 40,  y: 180 },
    { x: 103, y: 165 },
    { x: 166, y: 140 },
    { x: 229, y: 145 },
    { x: 291, y: 105 },
    { x: 354, y: 120 },
    { x: 417, y: 75 },
    { x: 480, y: 40 }
  ];

  var baseJpAmount = 1284561920;
  var totalJpVal = document.getElementById('ds-total-jp-val');

  function drawChart() {
    var linePath = document.getElementById('chart-line-path');
    var areaPath = document.getElementById('chart-area-path');
    if (!linePath || !areaPath) return;
    
    var d = '';
    chartPoints.forEach(function(p, i) {
      if (i === 0) {
        d += 'M ' + p.x + ' ' + p.y;
      } else {
        d += ' L ' + p.x + ' ' + p.y;
      }
    });
    
    linePath.setAttribute('d', d);
    var ad = d + ' L 480 200 L 40 200 Z';
    areaPath.setAttribute('d', ad);
    
    var lastP = chartPoints[chartPoints.length - 1];
    var node = document.getElementById('chart-active-node');
    if (node) {
      node.setAttribute('cx', lastP.x);
      node.setAttribute('cy', lastP.y);
      node.style.display = 'block';
    }
    
    var tooltip = document.getElementById('chart-tooltip');
    if (tooltip) {
      tooltip.setAttribute('transform', 'translate(' + (lastP.x - 65) + ', ' + (lastP.y - 42) + ')');
      tooltip.style.display = 'block';
      tooltip.querySelector('text').textContent = 'IDR ' + (baseJpAmount / 1000000000).toFixed(3) + 'B';
    }
  }

  function updateChartData() {
    chartPoints.forEach(function(p, i) {
      if (i > 0 && i < chartPoints.length - 1) {
        p.y += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 4;
        p.y = Math.max(30, Math.min(190, p.y));
      }
    });
    
    var lastP = chartPoints[chartPoints.length - 1];
    lastP.y += (Math.random() - 0.55) * 6;
    lastP.y = Math.max(20, Math.min(60, lastP.y));
    
    baseJpAmount += Math.floor(Math.random() * 8500) + 1500;
    if (totalJpVal) {
      totalJpVal.textContent = 'IDR ' + (baseJpAmount / 1000000000).toFixed(3) + 'B';
    }

    drawChart();
  }

  // Gacor Games Grid
  var GACOR_GAMES = [
    { name: 'Gates of Olympus 1000', provider: 'Pragmatic Play', emoji: '⚡', wr: 98.42, hours: '12:00 - 15:30' },
    { name: 'Mahjong Ways 2', provider: 'PG Soft', emoji: '🀄', wr: 98.95, hours: '19:00 - 22:30' },
    { name: 'Sweet Bonanza 1000', provider: 'Pragmatic Play', emoji: '🍬', wr: 97.80, hours: '08:00 - 11:30' },
    { name: 'Wild Bandito', provider: 'PG Soft', emoji: '🤠', wr: 96.72, hours: '16:00 - 18:30' },
    { name: 'Lucky Neko', provider: 'PG Soft', emoji: '🐱', wr: 97.45, hours: '21:00 - 23:45' }
  ];

  function isHourActive(rangeStr) {
    var now = new Date();
    var curHour = now.getHours();
    
    var parts = rangeStr.split(' - ');
    var startHour = parseInt(parts[0].split(':')[0]);
    var endHour = parseInt(parts[1].split(':')[0]);
    
    if (startHour <= endHour) {
      return curHour >= startHour && curHour < endHour;
    } else {
      return curHour >= startHour || curHour < endHour;
    }
  }

  function getBarColor(wr) {
    if (wr >= 98) return 'linear-gradient(90deg, #fbbf24, #f59e0b)';
    if (wr >= 97) return 'linear-gradient(90deg, #ec4899, #d946ef)';
    return 'linear-gradient(90deg, #3b82f6, #0ea5e9)';
  }

  var gacorListEl = document.getElementById('ds-gacor-list');

  function renderGacorList() {
    if (!gacorListEl) return;
    gacorListEl.innerHTML = '';
    
    GACOR_GAMES.forEach(function(game) {
      var activeClass = isHourActive(game.hours) ? ' active' : '';
      var activeText = isHourActive(game.hours) ? '🟢 LIVE' : '⏰ ';
      var wrClass = game.wr >= 98 ? ' super' : game.wr >= 97 ? ' hot' : '';
      
      var row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'ds-gacor-row';
      row.innerHTML = 
        '<div class="ds-row-main">' +
          '<div class="ds-game-info">' +
            '<span class="ds-game-icon">' + game.emoji + '</span>' +
            '<div class="ds-game-meta">' +
              '<span class="ds-game-name">' + game.name + '</span>' +
              '<span class="ds-game-provider">' + game.provider + '</span>' +
            '</div>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="ds-game-metrics">' +
            '<div class="ds-game-hours' + activeClass + '">' +
              '<span>' + activeText + ' ' + game.hours + ' WIB</span>' +
            '</div>' +
            '<div class="ds-game-winrate">' +
              '<span class="ds-wr-label">WIN RATE</span>' +
              '<span class="ds-wr-value' + wrClass + '">' + game.wr.toFixed(2) + '%</span>' +
            '</div>' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="ds-progress-wrap">' +
          '<div class="ds-progress-bar" style="width: ' + game.wr + '%; background: ' + getBarColor(game.wr) + '"></div>' +
        '</div>';
      
      gacorListEl.appendChild(row);
    });
  }

  function updateWinRates() {
    GACOR_GAMES.forEach(function(game) {
      game.wr += (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.15;
      game.wr = Math.max(94.0, Math.min(99.8, game.wr));
    });
    renderGacorList();
  }

  // Initialize Gacor dashboard
  drawChart();
  renderGacorList();
  
  // Update live statistics and chart
  setInterval(updateChartData, 4000);
  setInterval(updateWinRates, 3000);

  // ==========================================
  // LIVE ACTIVITY MONITOR SIMULATOR
  // ==========================================
  
  var actOnlineEl = document.getElementById('act-online-count');
  var actNewEl = document.getElementById('act-new-count');
  
  var totalOnline = 42851;
  var totalNew = 3812;
  
  // Player counts per game
  var ACTIVE_GAMES = [
    { name: 'Gates of Olympus 1000', provider: 'Pragmatic Play', emoji: '⚡', players: 12852 },
    { name: 'Mahjong Ways 2', provider: 'PG Soft', emoji: '🀄', players: 9421 },
    { name: 'Sweet Bonanza 1000', provider: 'Pragmatic Play', emoji: '🍬', players: 7819 },
    { name: 'Starlight Princess 1000', provider: 'Pragmatic Play', emoji: '👑', players: 6432 },
    { name: 'Wild Bandito', provider: 'PG Soft', emoji: '🤠', players: 5120 }
  ];

  // Regions list
  var REGIONS = [
    { name: 'DKI Jakarta', players: 14821 },
    { name: 'Yogyakarta', players: 5420 },
    { name: 'Semarang', players: 4912 },
    { name: 'Palembang', players: 4120 },
    { name: 'Solo', players: 3852 },
    { name: 'Riau', players: 3240 },
    { name: 'Bogor', players: 3110 },
    { name: 'Samarinda', players: 2450 },
    { name: 'Aceh', players: 2110 }
  ];

  var gameActivityEl = document.getElementById('ds-game-activity');
  var regionListEl = document.getElementById('ds-region-list');

  function renderGameActivity() {
    if (!gameActivityEl) return;
    gameActivityEl.innerHTML = '';
    
    ACTIVE_GAMES.forEach(function(game) {
      var row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'game-act-row';
      row.innerHTML = 
        '<div class="game-act-info">' +
          '<span class="game-act-icon">' + game.emoji + '</span>' +
          '<span class="game-act-name">' + game.name + '</span>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="game-act-count-wrap">' +
          '<span class="game-act-count">' + game.players.toLocaleString('id-ID') + '</span>' +
          '<span class="game-act-status">Aktif Main</span>' +
        '</div>';
      gameActivityEl.appendChild(row);
    });
  }

  function renderRegions() {
    if (!regionListEl) return;
    regionListEl.innerHTML = '';
    
    // Sort regions descending by player counts to show highest first
    REGIONS.sort(function(a, b) { return b.players - a.players; });
    
    REGIONS.forEach(function(reg) {
      var row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'region-row';
      row.innerHTML = 
        '<div class="region-info">' +
          '<span class="region-pin">📍</span>' +
          '<span class="region-name">' + reg.name + '</span>' +
        '</div>' +
        '<div class="region-count-wrap">' +
          '<span class="region-count">' + reg.players.toLocaleString('id-ID') + '</span>' +
          '<span class="region-status">Pemain Aktif</span>' +
        '</div>';
      regionListEl.appendChild(row);
    });
  }

  function updateActivityData() {
    // Fluctuating total online counts (+/- 15)
    var onlineDrift = Math.floor(Math.random() * 31) - 15;
    totalOnline += onlineDrift;
    if (actOnlineEl) {
      actOnlineEl.textContent = totalOnline.toLocaleString('id-ID');
      
      // Sync the glow bar width to drift between 80% and 95%
      var bar = actOnlineEl.closest('.overview-box').querySelector('.overview-glow-bar');
      if (bar) {
        var newWidth = Math.floor(Math.random() * 15) + 80;
        bar.style.width = newWidth + '%';
      }
    }
    
    // Incrementing new registers (+1 to +3)
    var newDrift = Math.floor(Math.random() * 3) + 1;
    totalNew += newDrift;
    if (actNewEl) {
      actNewEl.textContent = totalNew.toLocaleString('id-ID');
      
      // Sync new registers bar between 60% and 75%
      var bar = actNewEl.closest('.overview-box').querySelector('.overview-glow-bar');
      if (bar) {
        var newWidth = Math.floor(Math.random() * 15) + 60;
        bar.style.width = newWidth + '%';
      }
    }

    // Fluctuating players per game
    ACTIVE_GAMES.forEach(function(game) {
      game.players += Math.floor(Math.random() * 21) - 10;
      game.players = Math.max(100, game.players);
    });
    renderGameActivity();

    // Fluctuating players per region
    REGIONS.forEach(function(reg) {
      reg.players += Math.floor(Math.random() * 15) - 7;
      reg.players = Math.max(50, reg.players);
    });
    renderRegions();
  }

  // Initialize activity monitor displays
  renderGameActivity();
  renderRegions();

  // Run update simulations every 2.5 seconds
  setInterval(updateActivityData, 2500);
})();
</script>

<!-- FAQ -->

<div class="seo-box">
     <div class="seo-title">FAQ SEPUTARAN PORTAL NOLIMITHOKI</div>

     <details class="faq">
          <summary>Apa itu NOLIMITHOKI?</summary>
          <p>NOLIMITHOKI adalah platform slot online yang dikenal sebagai link slot gacor hari ini dan populer di kalangan pemain Indonesia. Situs ini disebut-sebut memiliki peluang kemenangan yang menarik serta menawarkan berbagai permainan slot dengan potensi maxwin tinggi.</p>
     </details>

     <details class="faq">
          <summary>Apakah NOLIMITHOKI bisa depo menggunakan QRIS?</summary>
          <p>Ya, NOLIMITHOKI menyediakan metode deposit menggunakan QRIS. Metode ini memudahkan pemain melakukan transaksi secara cepat, praktis, dan efisien hanya dengan melakukan scan melalui aplikasi e-wallet atau mobile banking yang mendukung QRIS.</p>
     </details>

     <details class="faq">
          <summary>Apa yang dimaksud dengan RTP 777 di NOLIMITHOKI?</summary>
          <p>RTP (Return to Player) 777 merujuk pada persentase pengembalian teoretis kepada pemain. Angka ini sering dikaitkan dengan peluang kemenangan yang lebih optimal, meskipun hasil permainan tetap bersifat acak dan bergantung pada sistem permainan.</p>
     </details>

     <details class="faq">
          <summary>ApakaApakah NOLIMITHOKI benar-benar memberikan JP nyata?</summary>
          <p>Banyak pemain mengklaim mendapatkan jackpot (JP) nyata saat bermain di NOLIMITHOKI. Namun, penting dipahami bahwa kemenangan dalam permainan slot tetap dipengaruhi oleh faktor keberuntungan dan sistem RNG (Random Number Generator).</p>
     </details>

     <details class="faq">
          <summary>BagaiMengapa NOLIMITHOKI disebut sebagai situs slot online 2026 terbaik?</summary>
          <p>NOLIMITHOKI disebut sebagai salah satu situs slot online 2026 terbaik karena kombinasi kemudahan transaksi (seperti QRIS), pilihan permainan yang beragam, serta reputasi yang berkembang di kalangan pemain slot Indonesia.</p>
     </details>

     <details class="faq">
          <summary>Bagaimana cara bermain secara bertanggung jawab?</summary>
          <p>Tetapkan batas waktu dan anggaran sebelum bermain, gunakan dana yang memang siap untuk kehilangan, dan jangan mengejar kerugian dengan meningkatkan taruhan. Jika aktivitas mulai mengganggu kebutuhan sehari-hari atau kondisi keuangan, sebaiknya hentikan permainan dan cari bantuan yang sesuai.</p>
     </details>
</div>

    <script nonce="TFNQUvYHwdi8uHoMheRs/Q==">
        //<![CDATA[

        trimGacUaCookies()
        trimGaSessionCookies()

        function trimGacUaCookies() {
            // Trim the list of gac cookies and only leave the most recent ones. This
            // prevents rejecting the request later on when the cookie size grows larger
            // than nginx buffers.
            let maxCookies = 15
            var gacCookies = []

            let cookies = document.cookie.split('; ')
            for (let i in cookies) {
                let [cookieName, cookieVal] = cookies[i].split('=', 2)
                if (cookieName.startsWith('_gac_UA')) {
                    gacCookies.push([cookieName, cookieVal])
                }
            }

            if (gacCookies.length <= maxCookies) {
                return
            }

            gacCookies.sort((a, b) => { return (a[1] > b[1] ? -1 : 1) })

            for (let i in gacCookies) {
                if (i < maxCookies) continue
                $.removeCookie(gacCookies[i][0], { path: '/', domain: '.' + window.location.host })
            }
        }

        function trimGaSessionCookies() {
            // Trim the list of ga session cookies and only leave the most recent ones. This
            // prevents rejecting the request later on when the cookie size grows larger
            // than nginx buffers.
            let maxCookies = 15
            var gaCookies = []
            // safelist our GA properties for production and staging
            const KEEPLIST = ['_ga_ZKBVC1X78F', '_ga_9Z72VQCKY0']

            let cookies = document.cookie.split('; ')
            for (let i in cookies) {
                let [cookieName, cookieVal] = cookies[i].split('=', 2)

                // explicitly ensure the cookie starts with `_ga_` so that we don't accidentally include
                // the `_ga` cookie
                if (cookieName.startsWith('_ga_')) {
                    if (KEEPLIST.includes(cookieName)) { continue }

                    gaCookies.push([cookieName, cookieVal])
                }
            }

            if (gaCookies.length <= maxCookies) {
                return
            }

            gaCookies.sort((a, b) => { return (a[1] > b[1] ? -1 : 1) })

            for (let i in gaCookies) {
                if (i < maxCookies) continue
                $.removeCookie(gaCookies[i][0], { path: '/', domain: '.' + window.location.host })
            }
        }

        //]]>
    </script>

<script>
(function(){
  'use strict';

  var GAMES = [
    { name:'Gates of Olympus 1000', provider:'Pragmatic Play',  rtp:96.50, vol:'HIGH', volLv:5, mw:10000 },
    { name:'Mahjong Ways 2',        provider:'PG Soft',         rtp:96.95, vol:'HIGH', volLv:5, mw:25000 },
    { name:'Sweet Bonanza 1000',    provider:'Pragmatic Play',  rtp:96.48, vol:'HIGH', volLv:5, mw:20000 },
    { name:'Starlight Princess 1000',provider:'Pragmatic Play', rtp:96.50, vol:'HIGH', volLv:4, mw:5000  },
    { name:'Sugar Rush 1000',       provider:'Pragmatic Play',  rtp:96.53, vol:'HIGH', volLv:5, mw:10000 },
    { name:'Wild Bandito',          provider:'PG Soft',         rtp:96.72, vol:'MED',  volLv:3, mw:7272  },
    { name:'Treasure of Aztec',     provider:'PG Soft',         rtp:96.86, vol:'HIGH', volLv:4, mw:100000 },
    { name:'Gates of Gatot Kaca 1000', provider:'Pragmatic Play', rtp:96.50, vol:'HIGH', volLv:5, mw:5000   },
    { name:'The Dog House Megaways',provider:'Pragmatic Play',  rtp:96.55, vol:'HIGH', volLv:5, mw:12305 },
    { name:'Wild West Gold',        provider:'Pragmatic Play',  rtp:96.51, vol:'HIGH', volLv:4, mw:10000 },
    { name:'Big Bass Bonanza',      provider:'Pragmatic Play',  rtp:96.71, vol:'HIGH', volLv:4, mw:2100  },
    { name:'Fortune Tiger',         provider:'PG Soft',         rtp:96.81, vol:'LOW',  volLv:2, mw:2500  },
    { name:'Spaceman',              provider:'Pragmatic Play',  rtp:96.50, vol:'HIGH', volLv:6, mw:5000  },
    { name:'Mahjong Wins',          provider:'PG Soft',         rtp:96.98, vol:'HIGH', volLv:4, mw:10000 },
    { name:'Lucky Neko',            provider:'PG Soft',         rtp:96.74, vol:'MED',  volLv:3, mw:7500  },
  ];

  var INTERVAL_MS = 6000;
  var cur = 0;
  var timerSec = INTERVAL_MS / 1000;
  var ticksLeft = timerSec;

  /* Elements */
  var E = function(id){ return document.getElementById(id); };
  var card     = E('dna-card');
  var gnameEl  = E('dna-gname');
  var pnameEl  = E('dna-pname');
  var rankEl   = E('dna-rank');
  var rtpValEl = E('dna-rtp-val');
  var rtpBar   = E('dna-rtp-bar');
  var rtpRank  = E('dna-rtp-rank');
  var volValEl = E('dna-vol-val');
  var pills    = [E('vp0'),E('vp1'),E('vp2'),E('vp3'),E('vp4'),E('vp5')];
  var mwChip   = E('dna-mw-chip');
  var mwNum    = E('dna-maxwin-num');
  var timerFill= E('dna-timer-fill');
  var timerTxt = E('dna-timer-txt');
  var curEl    = E('dna-cur');
  var totEl    = E('dna-tot');

  totEl.textContent = GAMES.length;

  function rand(a,b,dp){ return parseFloat((Math.random()*(b-a)+a).toFixed(dp||2)); }

  function fmtNum(n){ return n.toLocaleString('en-US'); }

  function volColor(v){
    if(v==='LOW') return '#10b981';
    if(v==='MED') return '#f59e0b';
    return '#ef4444';
  }
  function volBg(v){
    if(v==='LOW') return 'linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(16,185,129,0.1), rgba(16,185,129,0.05))';
    if(v==='MED') return 'linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(245,158,11,0.1), rgba(245,158,11,0.05))';
    return 'linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(239,68,68,0.1), rgba(239,68,68,0.05))';
  }
  function pillClass(i, lv){
    if(i >= lv) return 'dna-vol-pill';
    if(lv <= 2) return 'dna-vol-pill pill-low';
    if(lv <= 4) return i < 2 ? 'dna-vol-pill pill-low' : i < 4 ? 'dna-vol-pill pill-mid' : 'dna-vol-pill pill-high';
    return i < 2 ? 'dna-vol-pill pill-low' : i < 3 ? 'dna-vol-pill pill-mid' : 'dna-vol-pill pill-high';
  }

  function animCount(el, target){
    var start = parseInt(el.textContent.replace(/[^0-9]/g,'')) || 0;
    var diff = target - start, steps = 25, s = 0;
    var t = setInterval(function(){
      s++;
      var p = s/steps;
      var e = 1-Math.pow(1-p,3);
      el.textContent = fmtNum(Math.round(start + diff*e));
      if(s>=steps){ clearInterval(t); el.textContent = fmtNum(target); }
    }, 28);
  }

  function applyGame(g, idx){
    var rtp = rand(g.rtp - 0.35, g.rtp + 0.35);
    var mw  = Math.round(g.mw + rand(-g.mw*0.04, g.mw*0.04));

    gnameEl.textContent  = g.name;
    pnameEl.textContent  = g.provider;
    rankEl.textContent   = '#' + (idx+1);

    rtpValEl.textContent = rtp.toFixed(2) + '%';
    rtpBar.style.width   = rtp + '%';
    rtpRank.textContent  = 'Top ' + (idx+1);

    volValEl.textContent = g.vol;
    volValEl.style.color = volColor(g.vol);
    card.style.background = volBg(g.vol);

    pills.forEach(function(p,i){ p.className = pillClass(i, g.volLv); });

    var mwLabel = g.mw >= 10000 ? 'JACKPOT' : g.mw >= 5000 ? 'MEGA WIN' : 'BIG WIN';
    mwChip.textContent = mwLabel;

    animCount(mwNum, mw);
    curEl.textContent = idx+1;
  }

  function nextGame(){
    /* Fade out */
    card.classList.add('fade-out');
    setTimeout(function(){
      cur = (cur+1) % GAMES.length;
      applyGame(GAMES[cur], cur);
      card.classList.remove('fade-out');
      card.classList.add('fade-in');
      setTimeout(function(){ card.classList.remove('fade-in'); }, 400);
    }, 350);
  }

  /* Timer bar tick */
  function startTimer(){
    ticksLeft = timerSec;
    timerFill.style.width = '100%';
    timerTxt.textContent = timerSec + 's';
    var t = setInterval(function(){
      ticksLeft -= 1;
      if(ticksLeft <= 0){ clearInterval(t); return; }
      var pct = (ticksLeft / timerSec) * 100;
      timerFill.style.width = pct + '%';
      timerTxt.textContent = ticksLeft + 's';
    }, 1000);
  }

  /* Bootstrap */
  applyGame(GAMES[0], 0);
  startTimer();

  setInterval(function(){
    nextGame();
    startTimer();
  }, INTERVAL_MS);

  /* Also drift the RTP slightly every 2s for extra life */
  setInterval(function(){
    var g = GAMES[cur];
    var rtp = rand(g.rtp - 0.3, g.rtp + 0.3);
    rtpValEl.textContent = rtp.toFixed(2) + '%';
    rtpBar.style.width = rtp + '%';
  }, 2000);

  /* ========================================================================= */
  /* ===== LIVE DEPOSIT & WITHDRAW CONTROLLERS ===== */
  /* ========================================================================= */
  var DEPO_LIST = E('depo-list');
  var WD_LIST = E('wd-list');
  var DEPO_COUNT_BADGE = E('depo-count-badge');
  var WD_COUNT_BADGE = E('wd-count-badge');

  var USER_PREFIXES = ['ahmad', 'budi', 'hendra', 'luna', 'galang', 'hasan', 'johan', 'leopold', 'mueng', 'sri', 'dian', 'rizky', 'bagus', 'adit', 'eka', 'putra', 'dewi', 'mega'];
  var BANK_METHODS = [
    { name: 'bca', class: 'method-bca' },
    { name: 'dana', class: 'method-dana' },
    { name: 'ovo', class: 'method-ovo' },
    { name: 'gopay', class: 'method-gopay' },
    { name: 'mandiri', class: 'method-mandiri' },
    { name: 'bri', class: 'method-bri' }
  ];

  var activeDepoCount = 2481;
  var activeWdCount = 1894;

  function genMaskedUser() {
    var p = USER_PREFIXES[Math.floor(Math.random() * USER_PREFIXES.length)];
    var randSfx = Math.floor(Math.random() * 900) + 100; // 3 digits
    return p.substring(0, 3) + '***' + randSfx;
  }

  function genRandomAmount(type) {
    if (type === 'depo') {
      // 10K to 500K
      var val = (Math.floor(Math.random() * 49) + 1) * 10000;
      return '+IDR ' + val.toLocaleString('id-ID');
    } else {
      // 50K to 5M
      var val = (Math.floor(Math.random() * 99) + 1) * 50000;
      return 'IDR ' + val.toLocaleString('id-ID');
    }
  }

  function createTxRow(type) {
    var user = genMaskedUser();
    var amt = genRandomAmount(type);
    var method = BANK_METHODS[Math.floor(Math.random() * BANK_METHODS.length)];
    var initial = user.charAt(0).toUpperCase();

    var div = document.createElement('div');
    div.className = 'tx-row fade-in';
    div.innerHTML = 
      '<div class="tx-user-info">' +
        '<div class="tx-avatar" style="background: ' + (type === 'depo' ? 'linear-gradient(135deg, #065f46, #10b981)' : 'linear-gradient(135deg, #9a3412, #f59e0b)') + '">' + initial + '</div>' +
        '<div class="tx-user">' +
          '<span class="tx-username">' + user + '</span>' +
          '<span class="tx-time">Just now</span>' +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>' +
      '<span class="tx-method ' + method.class + '">' + method.name + '</span>' +
      '<div class="tx-status-wrap">' +
        '<span class="tx-amount ' + (type === 'depo' ? 'depo' : 'wd') + '">' + amt + '</span>' +
        '<span class="tx-status ' + (type === 'depo' ? 'success-depo' : 'success-wd') + '">✅ SUKSES</span>' +
      '</div>';
    return div;
  }

  // Pre-populate lists
  for (var i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
    DEPO_LIST.appendChild(createTxRow('depo'));
    WD_LIST.appendChild(createTxRow('wd'));
  }

  // Interval to transition: 1 data disappears, then 1 new data appears
  var toggleList = 'depo';

  setInterval(function() {
    var targetList = (toggleList === 'depo') ? DEPO_LIST : WD_LIST;
    var type = toggleList;
    toggleList = (toggleList === 'depo') ? 'wd' : 'depo';

    var children = targetList.children;
    if (children.length === 0) return;

    // 1 data hilang (fade-out the last child)
    var lastChild = children[children.length - 1];
    lastChild.classList.add('fade-out');

    // Update active user count slightly
    if (type === 'depo') {
      activeDepoCount += (Math.random() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1) * (Math.floor(Math.random() * 3) + 1);
      DEPO_COUNT_BADGE.textContent = '🟢 ' + activeDepoCount.toLocaleString('id-ID') + ' LIVE';
    } else {
      activeWdCount += (Math.random() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1) * (Math.floor(Math.random() * 3) + 1);
      WD_COUNT_BADGE.textContent = '🟢 ' + activeWdCount.toLocaleString('id-ID') + ' LIVE';
    }

    // After animation ends, remove it and insert the new row at the top
    setTimeout(function() {
      if (lastChild.parentNode) {
        lastChild.parentNode.removeChild(lastChild);
      }
      
      // Update older times
      for (var j = 0; j < targetList.children.length; j++) {
        var timeEl = targetList.children[j].querySelector('.tx-time');
        if (timeEl) {
          timeEl.textContent = ((j + 1) * 3) + 's ago';
        }
      }

      // 1 data muncul (insert new row at top)
      var newRow = createTxRow(type);
      targetList.insertBefore(newRow, targetList.firstChild);
    }, 400);

  }, 1800); // Shift every 1.8 seconds alternating

  /* ========================================================================= */
  /* ===== BUKTI WITHDRAW RECEIPT CONTROLLER ===== */
  /* ========================================================================= */
  var WD_GAMES = ['Mahjong Ways 2', 'Gates of Olympus 1000', 'Sweet Bonanza 1000', 'Treasure of Aztec', 'Wild Bandito', 'Starlight Princess 1000', 'Lucky Neko'];
  var BANK_NAMES = ['BCA', 'DANA', 'OVO', 'GOPAY', 'Mandiri', 'BRI', 'LinkAja'];

  function createWDProofCard(user, amt, game, bank, txId, timeStr) {
    var initial = user.charAt(0).toUpperCase();
    var cleanBank = bank.toLowerCase();
    var bankClass = 'method-' + cleanBank;
    if (cleanBank === 'linkaja') bankClass = 'method-ovo'; // Fallback style

    return (
      '<div class="wd-proof-card">' +
        '<img src="https://ismydrive.com/cdn/Logo%20NOLIMITHOKI%20Horizontal.png" class="wd-proof-watermark" alt="NOLIMITHOKI Watermark">' +
        '<div class="wd-proof-content">' +
          '<div class="wd-proof-header">' +
            '<span class="wd-proof-status-badge">• SUCCESS</span>' +
            '<span class="wd-proof-id">' + txId + '</span>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="wd-proof-amount-wrap">' +
            '<span class="wd-proof-amount-label">WITHDRAWAL APPROVED</span>' +
            '<div class="wd-proof-amount">' + amt + '</div>' +
          '</div>' +
          '<div class="wd-proof-details">' +
            '<div class="wd-proof-row">' +
              '<span class="wd-proof-label">Member:</span>' +
              '<span class="wd-proof-val">' + user + '</span>' +
            '</div>' +
            '<div class="wd-proof-row">' +
              '<span class="wd-proof-label">Permainan:</span>' +
              '<span class="wd-proof-val" style="color:#7dd3fc">' + game + '</span>' +
            '</div>' +
            '<div class="wd-proof-row">' +
              '<span class="wd-proof-label">Metode:</span>' +
              '<span class="wd-proof-val method-highlight ' + bankClass + '">' + bank + '</span>' +
            '</div>' +
            '<div class="wd-proof-row">' +
              '<span class="wd-proof-label">Tanggal:</span>' +
              '<span class="wd-proof-val">' + timeStr + '</span>' +
            '</div>' +
          '</div>' +
        '</div>' +
      '</div>'
    );
  }

  function genRandomWDProof() {
    var user = genMaskedUser();
    
    // Amount 250K to 15M
    var amtVal = (Math.floor(Math.random() * 59) + 1) * 250000;
    var amt = 'IDR ' + amtVal.toLocaleString('id-ID');
    
    var game = WD_GAMES[Math.floor(Math.random() * WD_GAMES.length)];
    var bank = BANK_NAMES[Math.floor(Math.random() * BANK_NAMES.length)];
    
    var txId = 'WD-' + (Math.floor(Math.random() * 899999) + 100000);
    
    // Time formatting
    var d = new Date();
    var pad = function(n) { return n < 10 ? '0' + n : n; };
    var timeStr = pad(d.getDate()) + '-' + pad(d.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + d.getFullYear() + ' ' + pad(d.getHours()) + ':' + pad(d.getMinutes()) + ':' + pad(d.getSeconds());

    return { user: user, amt: amt, game: game, bank: bank, txId: txId, timeStr: timeStr };
  }

  // Pre-populate proof card wraps
  for (var k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
    var wrap = E('wd-proof-' + k);
    if (wrap) {
      var data = genRandomWDProof();
      wrap.innerHTML = createWDProofCard(data.user, data.amt, data.game, data.bank, data.txId, data.timeStr);
    }
  }

  // 1 hilang 1 muncul secara bergantian
  var currentFlipSlot = 0;
  setInterval(function() {
    var slotId = 'wd-proof-' + currentFlipSlot;
    var wrap = E(slotId);
    if (!wrap) return;

    var card = wrap.querySelector('.wd-proof-card');
    if (!card) return;

    // 1 data hilang
    card.classList.add('flipping');

    setTimeout(function() {
      // 1 data muncul
      var data = genRandomWDProof();
      wrap.innerHTML = createWDProofCard(data.user, data.amt, data.game, data.bank, data.txId, data.timeStr);
      
      var newCard = wrap.querySelector('.wd-proof-card');
      if (newCard) {
        newCard.classList.add('flipping');
        newCard.offsetHeight; // trigger reflow
        newCard.classList.remove('flipping');
      }
    }, 600);

    currentFlipSlot = (currentFlipSlot + 1) % 3;

  }, 4000);

  /* Toggle / Close handlers */
  var closeBtn = E('dna-close-btn');
  var pillBtn  = E('dna-pill-btn');
  var widget   = E('game-dna-widget');

  if (closeBtn) {
    closeBtn.addEventListener('click', function(e){
      e.stopPropagation();
      if (widget) widget.classList.add('dna-collapsed');
    });
  }
  if (pillBtn) {
    pillBtn.addEventListener('click', function(e){
      e.stopPropagation();
      if (widget) widget.classList.remove('dna-collapsed');
    });
  }
})();
</script>

<script>
(function() {
  'use strict';
  
  var popup = document.getElementById('toto-popup');
  var closeBtn = document.getElementById('toto-popup-close');
  
  // Show popup on page load after a short delay
  window.addEventListener('load', function() {
    setTimeout(function() {
      popup.classList.add('show');
    }, 850);
  });
  
  function closePopup() {
    popup.classList.remove('show');
  }
  
  closeBtn.addEventListener('click', closePopup);
  
  // Close popup by clicking backdrop
  popup.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
    if (e.target === popup) {
      closePopup();
    }
  });
  
  // Close by pressing Escape key
  window.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) {
    if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      closePopup();
    }
  });
})();
</script>
